items.title: Add shared evidence artifact storage primitives for candidate-only artifacts
items.context: Create a minimal reusable evidence artifact envelope/store under packages/main/src/core/evidence following docs/evidence/evidence-platform-architecture.md. It should write immutable artifacts under .lattice/evidence and avoid handler-level direct file writes.
items.userSees: repro_probe stores an immutable candidate-only artifact and prints artifactId, digest, and evidenceScope=candidate-only.

happy.desc: Creating a candidate artifact writes an immutable digest-addressed object and a stable ref under .lattice/evidence.

edge.desc: Writing the same artifact payload is idempotent by digest and does not mutate the stored object.

adversarial.desc: Candidate-only artifacts expose evidenceScope=candidate-only and cannot be classified as production or DONE admissible evidence by this MVP.
